title: Retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount Hook with 2-1/2-Inch Pull-Out Hanging Space (Carolina Collection) | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bath or dressing area with a retractable hooks and garment rod wall mount hook that pulls out for 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then slides back in to stay neatly out of the way.

  • Retractable design: Provides 2-1/2" of hanging space when extended
  • Coordinated look: Designed to pair with the Carolina collection for matching Carolina traditional bathroom hardware
  • Material: Solid brass construction
  • Capacity: Holds up to 15 lb
  • Customizable tip: Remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob (optional)

Specs

  • Overall size: 3.75" W x 1.75" H x 1.75" L
  • Projection (retracted): 1"
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Fits standard interior walls

Installation

  • Drilling required: 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
  • All mounting hardware included (6/32 toggles)
  • Assembly required: No

Finish options

Available in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors, to coordinate with heritage bathroom fixtures and classic bath accessories.

_previous.title: Carolina Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
